description: This file defines the ConfigService class which manages configuration settings for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides methods to retrieve and modify various configuration parameters related to localization, security, LDAP, time settings, and integrations.

classes.name: ConfigService
classes.description: Service class for managing system configuration parameters, including localization, security policies, LDAP settings, time configurations, and integrations.

methods.name: getConfigDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ConfigDao, creating a new one if not already initialized.

methods.name: setConfigDao
methods.description: Sets the ConfigDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: _getConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration key.

methods.name: _setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a configuration key.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the timesheet period has been set.

methods.name: isSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Checks if supervisor chain feature is supported.

methods.name: setSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Enables or disables support for supervisor chain.

methods.name: setShowPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Sets whether to show deprecated PIM fields.

methods.name: showPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Returns whether deprecated PIM fields are shown.

methods.name: setShowPimSSN
methods.description: Sets whether to show SSN in PIM.

methods.name: showPimSSN
methods.description: Returns whether SSN is shown in PIM.

methods.name: setShowPimSIN
methods.description: Sets whether to show SIN in PIM.

methods.name: showPimSIN
methods.description: Returns whether SIN is shown in PIM.

methods.name: setShowPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Sets whether to show tax exemptions in PIM.

methods.name: showPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Returns whether tax exemptions are shown in PIM.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default admin localization language.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationUseBrowserLanguage
methods.description: Configures whether to use browser language for localization.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationDefaultDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the default date format for admin localization.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationUseBrowserLanguage
methods.description: Checks if browser language is used for localization.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationDefaultDateFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the default date format.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the default localization language.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Returns the default start time for work shifts.

methods.name: setDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Sets the default start time for work shifts.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Returns the default end time for work shifts.

methods.name: setDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Sets the default end time for work shifts.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Calculates and returns the length of the default work shift in hours.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Retrieves all configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Retrieves the value indicating if OpenID provider has been added.

methods.name: setOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Sets the OpenID provider added flag.

methods.name: getIntegrationsConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for open source integrations.

methods.name: setIntegrationsConfigValue
methods.description: Sets the configuration for open source integrations.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the instance identifier value.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the instance identifier.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path for sendmail.

methods.name: getMaxAttachmentSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed size for attachments.

methods.name: getAllowedFileTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of allowed file MIME types.

methods.name: getAllowedFileExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of allowed file extensions for uploads.

methods.name: getTimeSheetPeriodConfig
methods.description: Gets the timesheet period configuration value.

methods.name: setTimeSheetPeriodConfig
methods.description: Sets the timesheet period configuration value.

methods.name: setTimeSheetPeriodSetValue
methods.description: Marks the timesheet period as set or unset.

methods.name: getTimesheetTimeFormatConfig
methods.description: Fetches the timesheet time format setting.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP configuration settings.

methods.name: setLDAPSetting
methods.description: Stores LDAP configuration settings.

methods.name: getDashboardEmployeesOnLeaveTodayShowOnlyAccessibleConfig
methods.description: Checks if dashboard employees on leave today are limited to accessible ones.

methods.name: setDashboardEmployeesOnLeaveTodayShowOnlyAccessibleConfig
methods.description: Configures whether to limit dashboard employees on leave today to accessible ones.

methods.name: showSystemCheckScreen
methods.description: Checks if system check screen is enabled.

methods.name: setShowSystemCheckScreen
methods.description: Enables or disables system check screen.

methods.name: getOAuthEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth encryption key.

methods.name: getOAuthTokenEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth token encryption key.

methods.name: getOAuthAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for OAuth auth codes as a DateInterval.

methods.name: getOAuthRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for OAuth refresh tokens as a DateInterval.

methods.name: getOAuthAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for OAuth access tokens as a DateInterval.
